title: Me and the Devil Blues: The Unreal Life of Robert Johnson
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 1929 Mississippi, plantation worker Robert Johnson dreams of playing the blues. After a failed performance he performs the crossroads ritual, and after a night in a cemetery he plays brilliantly, only to find six months have vanished and his pregnant girlfriend Virginia has died in childbirth. He leaves home, trains with mentor Ike Zimmerman, and travels the South with outlaw Clyde Barrow, confronting white supremacists while haunted by his deal with the devil. A fictionalized, Southern Gothic take on a real musician.
life_message: Art and freedom come at a heavy price, and the story asks what a man gives up to pursue them.
